title: Quaternionic division points on curves in the Siegel threefold

abstractEnglish: We prove the quaternionic-division component of Zilber–Pink for curves in $`\mathcal A_2`$ over $`\overline{\mathbb Q}`$. A Hodge-generic algebraic curve contains only finitely many points whose full geometric rational endomorphism algebra is an indefinite quaternion division algebra over ℚ. No boundary or reduction hypothesis is required.
